related_tactics.name: Mystical Manipulation
related_tactics.definition: Engineering experiences that appear spontaneous, spiritual, or divinely ordained but are actually staged by leadership, used to demonstrate the group's special connection to higher powers and the leader's supernatural authority.

related_tactics.name: Demand for Purity
related_tactics.definition: Dividing the world into absolute categories of pure and impure, good and evil, creating an environment of perpetual guilt and shame where members can never be righteous enough and must submit to the group's authority for moral guidance.

related_tactics.name: Sacred Science
related_tactics.definition: Elevating the group's ideology to the status of absolute, unquestionable, sacred truth that transcends ordinary evidence or rational challenge — any doubt is not intellectual.

related_tactics.name: Doctrine Over Person
related_tactics.definition: Systematically subordinating personal experience, perception, and memory to group doctrine, so that when a member's lived experience contradicts the ideology, they are taught that their experience is wrong rather than that the doctrine is flawed.

related_tactics.name: Bounded Choice
related_tactics.definition: Restructuring a member's reality so completely that all choices feel internally motivated and freely made, while the actual option space has been constrained to only choices that serve the group — freedom is experienced subjectively while objectively eliminated.

entries.name: Forced Confession / Self-Criticism Rituals

approved_draft.why_this_matters: Material surrendered under group pressure does not go away; it stays available as leverage, and the habit of confessing on demand leaves a person with no private ground of their own to stand on.
approved_draft.what_it_is_not: Accountability practices exist in healthy settings too — step work, clinical supervision, team retrospectives, restorative circles — and saying something difficult in front of a group is not itself harmful. The difference lies in whether disclosure is voluntary and bounded, or required, open-ended, and recalled against the person afterwards.
approved_draft.note: Derived from the expanded definition alone; the false-positive material on this Reference-only entry is generic scaffolding shared across the category.
